title: Quartic onsite obstruction to a positive-strip Weyl-Fourier carrier
question: Does the natural positive-strip L1 Weyl-Fourier analytic carrier remain invariant under the exact quartic onsite multiplication subflow?
method: Restrict to the one-component quartic onsite potential V(q)=G q^4/4 and the translation Weyl W_a=exp(-i a p/hbar), so the exact potential subflow produces the cubic phase exp(i t[V(q+a)-V(q)]/hbar).
Use the elementary weighted-Fourier implication: a finite positive exponential frequency moment gives a bounded holomorphic extension to every narrower complex strip.

Expand the exact cubic phase at z=x+i y and choose y with y*kappa<0. Its modulus grows as exp(3|kappa||y|x^2), contradicting boundedness in every nonzero strip. Recompute the exact rational coefficient in independent SymPy and Fraction lanes and compile Lean R238 for the arithmetic sign fixtures.
finding: The positive-strip L1 Weyl-Fourier carrier is not invariant even under the quartic onsite subflow for any nonzero translation and time: the cubic phase is unbounded in every nonzero complex strip, while a positive exponential Fourier moment would force bounded strip analyticity. Primary and independent lanes pass 20/20; integrated passes 31/31; Lean R238 passes.
decision_reason: This is the first exact test of the Weyl-Fourier analytic hierarchy left open by the fixed-beta OS-mixture route. It removes one named carrier without conflating the failure with nonexistence of Q3 dynamics or with the still-live radius-free, Gevrey, modular and state-weighted alternatives.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing route obstruction for a positive exponential Weyl-Fourier density/strip carrier. It does not reject all analytic/Frechet, Gevrey, modular/state-weighted or direct D and delta-D routes and does not establish a thermodynamic QFT.

The exact cubic coefficient kappa is nonzero and y*kappa<0 makes -Im(P) grow quadratically in x.
Radius-free, Gevrey and subexponential profiles are not tested or rejected.
R238 checks exact arithmetic fixtures only and cannot certify Fourier analysis or Q3 domains.
